input.question: Where is Lincoln County High School located?

documents.text: Lincoln County High School (West Virginia) Lincoln County High School is a Class AA high school in Hamlin, West Virginia. It was built between 2004 and 2006 and completed in time for the 2006/07 school year. Lincoln County High School was formed from four former high schools in the county: Guyan Valley High School in Pleasant View, Duval High School in Griffithsville, Hamlin High School in Hamlin, and Harts High School in Harts.
